item: A host that writes the socket guard's words in its status line is its own failure, not the person's airplane mode (the wrapped-refusal alternative of _OFFLINE_RE spelled out)
summary: R616, OPEN_QUEUE 2026-11-08 item 42 (found by the read of R614's second PR). The second alternative of fetch_verdict._OFFLINE_RE read 'request error for <url>: ' followed by anything and then the socket guard's words, and urllib3 quotes a status line it could not parse (('Connection aborted.', BadStatusLine('<the host's line>'))), so a host that wrote the guard's words as its status line was read as the person's airplane mode: a calendar feed then stayed skipped_offline and never climbed its re-check ladder, and a hostile feed in the sample left the feed preflight incomplete on every run. Reproduced live with a loopback server answering with those words as its status line (the guard lets loopback through). The alternative now spells urllib3's construction out from its first word with no gap: the pool sentence with host and port, a path token with no space, '(Caused by NewConnectionError(' (optionally led by the ProxyError urllib3 gives when the guard refused a proxy that is not on loopback, the shape the container's own proxy produces), the connection's host and port, then the guard's words; the host tokens take no whitespace, quote or backslash, as in the resolver alternative (R298). tests/test_refusal_wrapped_shape.py (16 cases) takes the real shapes from the real guard through real requests and urllib3 (https, http, a port, a refused proxy, and through EthicalFetcher.fetch), so a urllib3 that rewords its error turns it red instead of silently turning a Stop into a host failure; the live loopback reproduction and nine forged shapes built from the real exception objects are not read as offline; the old alternative is shown to have matched the first four. Passes on urllib3 2.7.0 (the lock) and 2.8.0. Seven mutants of the alternative are killed. Release-notes line: a server that answers with words copied from the app's airplane-mode refusal is no longer mistaken for airplane mode, so its source is checked again like any other failing source.
